== Introduction ==
* '''Website:''' http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql11/
* '''Gametype:''' [[4on4]] Team Deathmatch
* '''Number of teams:''' 36
* '''Structure:''' Divisions, 3
* '''Number of playoff teams:''' Top 8 of every division go to playoffs 
* '''Admins:''' [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Blixem]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[fog]], [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Itsinen]], [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Zalon]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Zappater]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Hooraytio]]
* '''Clients allowed:'''
:: [[ezQuake|ezQuake 1.9.3 stable (build 2572)]] & [[ezQuake|ezQuake 2.0 Stable]]
:: [[FTE|FTE 3343]]
:: [[FodQuake|FodQuake 0.2]]
* '''Map pool:''' [[DM2]], [[DM3]], [[E1M2]]
* '''Maps to win:''' [[Best of three]] (Divisions), [[Best of five]] (Finals)
* '''First game:''' 2010-03-07 - [[Image:flag_eu.gif]] [[teamkillers]] vs [[Image:flag_eu.gif]] [[Slackers]]
* '''Last game:''' 2010-05-09 - [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[The Viper Squad]] vs [[Image:flag_eu.gif]] [[Slackers]] ([http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql11/matches/220#Played match report])
